'''Ice spiders''' may be found when training [[Dungeoneering]] in the [[frozen floors]]. These spiders have low strength, defence, and life points for their level, but they hit very accurately, even through armour. They are weak to fire spells. Unlike elsewhere, these spiders show up on the minimap as yellow dots. [[Astea Frostweb]] also summons these spiders to aid her in combat.

==Drops==
The ice spiders summoned by [[Astea Frostweb]] do not drop anything.

{{Dungeoneering droptable|headings=3}}
